added: Themearr as a plug-in, outside the main install, on its own page on your home network.
**Reads your films from Reelix** with nothing to enter: Starboard gives Themearr Reelix's address and key, and its films folder.
**Your RapidAPI key** in its settings in Starboard, and the access token for Themearr's own page on its tab.
**A card** with how many films have a theme tune.

description: Themearr puts a theme tune, theme.mp3, in the folder of each film Reelix has, and Jellyfin plays it on the film's page. It needs a RapidAPI key to fetch the tunes.
name: Themearr

settings.hint: Themearr fetches each tune through the youtube-mp36 service on RapidAPI. Make a RapidAPI account, subscribe to youtube-mp36 (its free plan has a monthly limit) and enter the key it gives you.
settings.label: RapidAPI key

settings.hint: The user name of the same RapidAPI account.
settings.label: RapidAPI user name

settings.hint: Themearr finds a tune for each film and fetches it. Deactivated, you choose each tune on Themearr's own page.
settings.label: Fetch tunes for new films by itself

settings.hint: The access token Themearr's own page asks for once in each web browser.
